newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Metrobank plunges 10 pct in Manila.
newsitem.headline: Metrobank plunges 10 pct in Manila.

text.p: Metropolitan Bank and Trust Co dropped by 10.08 percent, or by 60 pesos, to 535 on Tuesday due to foreign sell down on fears Philippine banks were overexposed to the property sector, brokers said.
"Metrobank being the biggest bank, rightly or wrongly, got the brunt of the foreign funds fears over the Philippine banking sector," said Joey Salceda, director at SBC Warburg.
Henry Ong, research director at Sapphire Securities, said foreign funds were selling down the issue.
"The market has to cleanse the froth that attended the 37 percent annual growth in (Philippine bank) loans over the past four years," Salceda said.
"Obviously, this undermines the quality of the earnings of property companies as well as increases the risk profile of the balance sheet of banks," he added.
Some 259,210 shares of Metro Bank changed hands after 30 minutes of trade.
